steps.title: Health
steps.body: A state of complete physical, mental and social wellbeing, not merely the absence of disease or infirmity (WHO definition). Health has three interconnected dimensions: physical, emotional/mental, and social.

steps.title: Chemical Effects of Exercise on the Brain
steps.body: Serotonin → Improves mood, reduces depression Endorphins → Natural painkillers, create euphoria Dopamine → Reward and motivation, reinforces positive behaviour These chemical changes explain why regular exercise is such a powerful treatment for mental health conditions.

steps.title: PE Exam Tips — Physical, Emotional and Social Health
steps.body: 1. For Physical, Emotional and Social Health questions, use subject-specific terminology precisely 2. Support every point with specific evidence or examples 3. Show balanced analysis — consider different perspectives before reaching a conclusion 4. Link your understanding of Physical, Emotional and Social Health to real-world contexts where possible 5. For longer answers, plan your response to address all parts of the question

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Explain three physical health benefits of regular exercise. | How does exercise improve emotional and mental health? Refer to specific chemicals released during physical activity. | Describe three social health benefits of participating in sport and give a sporting example for each.

steps.title: Check your answers

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Organise your answer into physical, emotional and social categories Use specific chemical names: serotonin, endorphins, dopamine, cortisol Physical health = disease reduction (CHD, obesity, diabetes) plus fitness improvements Emotional health = mood, stress, self-esteem, emotional control, depression Social health = teamwork, cooperation, friends, belonging - give sport examples Remember the health triangle - all three dimensions are interconnected
